title: Chopchopchop
description: ChopChopChop makes tree felling feel natural and satisfying: logs show visible chopping progress, and the entire tree falls dynamically instead of breaking instantly or floating in mid-air.
body: ChopChopChop is an immersive tree felling mod that degrades log blocks visually and fells whole trees dynamically based on progress. Rather than instantly breaking single logs or causing trees to hover mid-air, logs accumulate "chops" when hit with an axe.
